correctness.rationale: If a colour occurs in all rows or columns then elementary cover bounds force at least 2n-1 labels; at weight 2n-2 each colour misses at least one row/column. Missing-row/column intersections A×B, C×D force the opposite colour, with A∩C=B∩D=empty. If remaining U,V sizes are u,v, w>=ab+cd+2max(u,v)>=2n-2+|u-v|. Equality gives u=v, ab=a+b-1, cd=c+d-1 and thus the two orientations with bar dimensions (1,s-1,s-1,1) or its complementary orientation; remaining u red and u blue occupied cells form disjoint U-to-V perfect matchings. !u counts the second after choosing the first (u!), and s=2 orientations coincide. Independently computed M_n for n=2..6 as 4,18,320,8450,295272 and brute-checked n=2,3 placements; verified source C++ checker by reading it without treating reported VERIFY_OK as proof.
residual_risks: Finite checker does not establish an infinite or arbitrary-size theorem
